Q1: How should the automation-path grant be supplied so implementation does not hit the same block again?
Choices:
A) The issue author (the pipeline account) or an OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR edits this issue's body to add the allowlist block shown below, at the start of a line on its own, then posts `/reclarify`. The guard checks the issue author and the current body, so an edit by a trusted maintainer is enough. The block (two-space indent, one path per line): (RECOMMENDED)
```
files_touched:
  - .github/workflows/mark-stable.yml
  - .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  - .github/workflows/ci.yml
  - scripts/release_ci_gate.sh
  - tests/test_release_ci_gate.py
```
B) Close this issue and have an OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR open a new issue with the spec and the block above at the root of its body.
C) Narrow the scope to the non-automation paths only (`tests/test_release_ci_gate.py`) and leave the release gate itself for a later issue.
**Note:** C does not deliver the release gate the spec requires, and #6532 must stay paused either way. Going ahead without A or B repeats the #6770 rejection.
